pages.text: Light, unbending, and stubborn to find — the skeleton of every Ultimate tool.

pages.title: Where It Grows
pages.text: Titanium runs deeper than uranium: thin veins below y=20 in the Overworld, and richer seams in the $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/mining_dimension)Mining Dimension$()'s crowded stone.$(p)Pair it with $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/uranium)Uranium$() and plain iron to craft the Ultimate line — sword, bow, tools and full armor. Expect to strip a few chunks bare for the set. It is worth it.
